 Lyon R1 previews and predictions: Humbert vs. Moutet, Norrie vs. Bonzi 
 October 19, 2026 
 Ricky 
 Match previews 
 2 
 First-round action in Lyon continues on Tuesday, when Frenchmen Ugo Humbert, Corentin Moutet, and Benjamin Bonzi take the court. Humbert and Moutet are going head-to-head, while Bonzi faces Cameron Norrie. 
 (7) Ugo Humbert vs. Corentin Moutet
It will be an all-French battle in front of the home crowd when Humbert and Moutet meet for the third time in their careers in round one of the Grand Prix Auvergne-Rhone-Alpes on Tuesday. Moutet has won both of their previous encounters — 6-3, 6-4 at the 2022 Paris Masters and via retirement while leading 6-4, 3-0 on the red clay of Rome in 2025.
 Andrew Patron/Delray Beach Open 
There is, however, plenty of good news for Humbert. The world No. 35 is generally outstanding on fast surfaces and he is the defending champion of this tournament. Moreover, Moutet is in horrendous form. The left-hander is 8-19 at the ATP level this season and will fall well outside the top 100 if he loses early in Lyon. Because of those factors, anything other than a routine victory for Humbert would be a considerable surprise.
 Pick: Humbert in 2

 Benjamin Bonzi vs. Cameron Norrie
Norrie and Bonzi will also be squaring off for the third time in their careers on Tuesday. Bonzi triumphed 7-6(6), 6-4 in the 2024 Metz final before Norrie got the job done 6-0, 6-7(2), 4-6, 6-3, 6-4 at the Australian Open earlier this year. As those results suggest, an indoor hard court — especially at home in France — probably favors Bonzi. The world No. 100 likes quick courts and he obviously thrives in front of the home crowd.
Although Norrie is an all-court player, he has done much of his best work on the natural surfaces — clay and grass. In this particular matchup, clay is certainly the surface on which the 40th-ranked Brit would choose to play. That’s not to say that he is without a chance indoors, but the edge will likely go to Bonzi.
 Pick: Bonzi in 3
